verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-configurable automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled or recurring jobs, background agents, or event-triggered agent tasks. Auto-deploy on push is a fixed CI/CD behavior, and the dashboard AI agents are one-off prompted actions rather than recurring schedules. The REST API, CLI, SDK and serverless functions are developer building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
